title: CR-001 Material-Driven Fashion Editorial
description: Original living high-end fashion editorial focused on garment architecture, fabric physics, refined grooming, and motivated studio light. Creative Research library entry; no gallery image attached. V2 wardrobe/hair/makeup/pose/environment JSON files are authoring vocabulary only and are not loaded by the compiler.

semantic_spec.request: Create a luxury fashion editorial photograph of an adult woman standing in a controlled studio, wearing an original architectural evening gown. Prioritize garment construction and material fidelity over generic beauty adjectives: a sculpted bodice with clean princess seams, a bias-cut skirt that falls in long continuous folds, and a satin-faced silk surface that shows directional specular ribbons following the cloth geometry. Hair is a sleek low chignon with a few controlled face-framing strands; makeup is polished editorial with defined eyes, restrained highlight, and visible natural skin texture. Keep the atmosphere quiet, expensive, and photographic rather than illustrative.

body_transformation.anatomy_change: none; preserve natural adult proportions without idealizing measurements
body_transformation.garment_shaping: architectural bodice with princess seams and internal support implied by clean vertical structure; bias-cut skirt that skims the hip then releases into a floor-grazing column; slight train weight pulling the hem into longer rear folds; no floating fabric panels

requested_elements: sculpted evening gown bodice with princess seams
bias-cut satin-faced silk skirt with continuous drape folds
sleek low chignon with restrained face-framing strands
seamless studio backdrop with controlled negative space

director.moment: the final settled stance after a slow turn, cloth still resolving into gravity
director.action: standing with one foot slightly advanced, torso quietly upright, shoulders relaxed into the bodice architecture
director.gaze: toward camera with calm, unsmiling editorial focus
director.body_weight: front advanced foot carries primary weight; rear foot lightly grounded for recoverable balance
director.hand_logic: near hand lightly gathers a fold of skirt at mid-thigh without pinching; far hand rests open along the opposite thigh seam
director.fabric_response: satin-faced silk shows long bias folds, tension at the bodice waist seam, and soft collapse where the train meets the floor; cloth responds to the recent turn with delayed settling rather than frozen wind
director.prop_interaction: no handheld props; hands interact only with the gown
director.foreground: soft falloff of the train edge and a narrow floor plane highlight
director.midground: full gown silhouette and subject stance reading as one vertical architecture
director.background: seamless warm-gray cyclorama with generous negative space on the non-key side
director.camera: eye-level three-quarter full-length editorial frame with slight subject offset from center
director.light_source: soft directional key from camera-left at chest height, large source, gentle fill from the right wall bounce, restrained rim separating shoulder and hair from the backdrop
director.material_response: satin highlights travel as continuous specular ribbons along fold crowns; matte skin and hair absorb light differently from the cloth; seam edges remain structurally readable without plastic sheen
director.micro_story: a quiet luxury fitting-room certainty translated into a still editorial beat

camera.description: Framing alternatives for the same garment and stance.
choices: eye-level three-quarter full-length editorial frame with slight subject offset from center
slightly low full-length frame emphasizing vertical gown architecture and train weight
eye-level medium-long frame cutting just below the knee to prioritize bodice seam logic and fabric speculars

light.description: Motivated lighting alternatives that keep material response photographic.
choices: soft directional key from camera-left at chest height, large source, gentle fill from the right wall bounce, restrained rim separating shoulder and hair from the backdrop
narrower camera-left key with deeper shadow falloff on the far side of the gown and a thin hair rim only
